summary.description: 2-3 sentences on the crypto market right now.

symbol.description: Pair exactly as listed, e.g. BTC/USD.

action.description: CANDIDATES (not held): buy or no_trade. HELD positions: hold, reduce or close. no_trade is a normal, often correct answer.

conviction.description: 0-100: how strongly the evidence supports the action. It is NOT a probability.

p_target_first.description: BUY only: probability 0-1 that take_profit is hit before stop_loss. A random walk gives stop_distance / (stop_distance + target_distance); deviate from that only as far as the evidence justifies. null otherwise.

stop_loss.description: BUY: stop price below the current price. HELD: a new stop price, or null to keep the current one.

take_profit.description: BUY: target price above the current price. HELD: a new target, or null to keep it.

horizon_hours.description: Expected holding period in hours (1-2160). When it elapses the position is reviewed, not sold.

size_pct_of_max.description: BUY only: 10-100, the share of the maximum position size the risk engine allows. Size down when uncertain. null otherwise.

reduce_pct.description: REDUCE only: % of the position to sell (10-90); the rest stays open with its stop and target. null otherwise.

priced_in.description: How much of the thesis or catalyst the price already reflects.

thesis.description: 2-3 sentences: why this action, why now. Cite numbers from CONTEXT or RESEARCH.

claim.description: One concrete statement, with numbers and dates where possible.

kind.description: fact = verifiable data (exchange numbers from CONTEXT, official announcements). sourced_claim = reported by a source in RESEARCH. estimate = your own quantitative estimate. speculation = plausible but unverified.

source_url.description: A URL that appears in RESEARCH and supports the claim, or null. Never invent URLs.

as_of.description: When the information was published or observed (ISO date/time), or null.

bear_evidence.description: 1-5 counterarguments and downside risks. Always include at least one.

risks.description: 1-4 key risk factors: event risk, liquidity, correlation with other holdings.

invalidation.description: The specific price level or event that proves the thesis wrong.

decisions.description: Exactly one decision per CANDIDATE and per HELD position listed. Nothing else.

data_gaps.description: Missing, stale or contradictory information that lowered confidence.

notification.description: One-line summary for the activity feed, max 160 characters.

symbol.description: Pair exactly as listed in SEED CANDIDATES, e.g. BTC/USD.

weight_pct.description: % of the seed amount for this pair (1-100). Weights across allocations sum to at most 100; anything left stays in cash.

conviction.description: 0-100: how strongly the evidence supports this pair as a long-term core holding. It is NOT a probability.

thesis.description: 2-3 sentences: why this is a good long-term core holding now. Cite numbers from CONTEXT or RESEARCH.

invalidation.description: The specific price level or event that would prove the long-term thesis wrong.

stop_loss.description: Stop price below the current price at a daily level (the hint is 2.5 daily ATR), or null to use the hint.

take_profit.description: Target price above the current price, or null to use the hint (3R).

horizon_hours.description: Expected holding period in hours (168-2160). When it elapses the position is reviewed, not sold.

rationale.description: 3-5 sentences on the allocation as a whole: why these pairs, why these weights, and the macro backdrop.
